about: Which files setup --print --site and doctor look at in a website's code folder: never inside skip_dirs (installed packages, build output, virtual environments, WordPress's own code); pages are the files ending in page_suffixes (a static site's), templates those ending in script_suffixes (where the cake.js line can be); a template that holds a page's </head> is looked for only among head_suffixes (markup and template files, never a plain .js or .ts file, which in a site's folder is more often a browser library than a page). Which framework a folder uses is data/frameworks.json. edge_folder: the folder of the sites' middleware (node, python, php, wordpress), inside the package in a release (agentcake/edge: the wheel, the .pyz and the unpacked package) and beside it in a checkout; $CAKE_EDGE_DIR names another one.
